Overview

Toluca is a city in Estado de México with a population of 936,145. High-altitude state capital with a rich industrial history and proximity to Mexico City. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 6a growing zone supports Cool to mild — apples, pears, berries, many vegetables. A large share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree or higher. Reported crime rates are relatively high.
